system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template defining a custom-mode VPC with two subnets (public, private), a Cloud NAT gateway for the private subnet, and firewall rules allowing internal traffic.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Create a GCP Deployment Manager template defining a custom-mode VPC with two subnets (public, private), a Cloud NAT gateway for the private subnet, and firewall rules allowing internal traffic.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: prod-vpc
  type: compute.v1.network
  properties:
    name: prod-vpc
    autoCreateSubnetworks: false
    routingConfig:
      routingMode: REGIONAL

- name: prod-public-subnet
  type: compute.v1.subnetwork
  properties:
    name: prod-public-subnet
    region: us-central1
    network: $(ref.prod-vpc.selfLink)
    ipCidrRange: 10.10.0.0/24
    privateIpGoogleAccess: false
    enableFlowLogs: true

- name: prod-private-subnet
  type: compute.v1.subnetwork
  properties:
    name: prod-private-subnet
    region: us-central1
    network: $(ref.prod-vpc.selfLink)
    ipCidrRange: 10.10.1.0/24
    privateIpGoogleAccess: true
    enableFlowLogs: true

- name: prod-nat-router
  type: compute.v1.router
  properties:
    name: prod-nat-router
    region: us-central1
    network: $(ref.prod-vpc.selfLink)
    nats:
    - name: prod-nat
      natIpAllocateOption: AUTO_ONLY
      sourceSubnetworkIpRangesToNat: LIST_OF_SUBNETWORKS
      subnetworks:
      - name: $(ref.prod-private-subnet.selfLink)
        sourceIpRangesToNat:
        - ALL_IP_RANGES
      minPortsPerVm: 128
      enableEndpointIndependentMapping: true
      udpIdleTimeoutSec: 30
      icmpIdleTimeoutSec: 30
      tcpEstablishedIdleTimeoutSec: 1200
      tcpTransitoryIdleTimeoutSec: 30
      logConfig:
        enable: true
        filter: ALL

- name: allow-internal
  type: compute.v1.firewall
  properties:
    name: allow-internal
    network: $(ref.prod-vpc.selfLink)
    direction: INGRESS
    priority: 1000
    sourceRanges:
    - 10.10.0.0/24
    - 10.10.1.0/24
    allowed:
    - IPProtocol: tcp
    - IPProtocol: udp
    - IPProtocol: icmp
    description: Allow internal traffic within VPC subnets

outputs:
- name: network
  value: $(ref.prod-vpc.selfLink)
- name: publicSubnet
  value: $(ref.prod-public-subnet.selfLink)
- name: privateSubnet
  value: $(ref.prod-private-subnet.selfLink)
- name: natRouter
  value: $(ref.prod-nat-router.selfLink)
